United States in Relief

A tabletop terrain model built from open elevation data

Tours

Layers

Elevation: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen, AWS Open Data). Land cover: NLCD 2021 (USGS). Coast, lakes, rivers, state lines: Natural Earth. Heights are exaggerated. Not for navigation.

How to move around

Orbit
Drag, or one finger. Keys Q and E.
Pan
Right-drag or Shift-drag, or two fingers. Arrow keys or W A S D.
Zoom
Scroll or pinch. Keys + and -. Double-click to fly to a spot.
Tours
Keys 1 to 9.
Other keys
L place names, B state lines, H hide the interface, R reset the view.

Elevation is real, sampled at 2.5 km and then sharpened with generated detail. Regional height is exaggerated more than local relief so mountain ranges read as masses. Hover the map for true elevation, state and coordinates.
